title: Kicking Your Balls (ORIGINAL)
description: On another evening in my dungeon I might perhaps have left something to the mystique. After all, I like my subs to arrive a little nervous in anticipation of what is to come. But something tells me that's not quite needed this time. Not when you already spelled it out to me so very very clearly beforehand. How you're such a tough man that you could take me kicking your balls. That you could handle my sadistic side and were ready to prove yourself... So tonight, I'm going to teach you to respect me on a whole new level. After I've tied you up, I'm going to hurt you. I'm going to exploit ALL your weaknesses down there and make you fear what I can do to you. Oh. Now what's that adorable look on your face, sweetie... Are you no longer looking forward to this play session? Or are you more than a little nervous? Don't worry, you don't have to answer that part just yet. All you have to do right now is get into a comfortable position and put on your headphones for me while I get everything set up. I'll still give you another chance to back out before we truly start.
author: Mistress Shibby
